description: This collection consists of 331 interviews with American frontline workers describing their experiences before, during, and after the height of the COVID-19 pandemic. The interviews were documented by StoryCorps staff across 30 different states, with some interviews also conducted online. Most interviews feature a single frontline worker, while others capture shared recollections between colleagues. Together, these interviews offer an important portrait of working Americans’ lives during the COVID-19 pandemic.
